description: This file defines the Vtiger_Menu class, providing an API to manage menus within the vtiger CRM system, including adding/removing modules, retrieving instances, and syncing menu data.

classes.name: Vtiger_Menu
classes.description: Class providing API to work with vtiger CRM Menu, including initialization, module management, and data synchronization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the menu instance with provided data.

methods.name: __getNextRelSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for related modules.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the menu.

methods.name: removeModule
methods.description: Removes a module from the menu.

methods.name: detachModule
methods.description: Detaches a module from all menus.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a menu instance by label or ID.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages for debugging or information.

methods.name: syncfile
methods.description: Synchronizes menu data to a flat file.
